sections.h2: China alone would hold 49% of the $228.5 billion rupee residual

chart.title: China's residual is by far the largest of the seven partners
chart.sub: Annual rupee residual by BRICS partner, US$ bn, FY2025-26.
chart.source: Ministry of Commerce TradeStat, FY2025-26; author's calculations.

sections.means: The residual is imports minus exports, and China's $131.6 billion of imports against $19.5 billion of exports makes it dominate the total.
sections.todo: Treat China separately, through import substitution and supply-chain diversification rather than currency policy.

sections.h2: Russia's reserves rose 4.5% in eleven months, all of it in gold

chart.title: Gold rose 17.3% while the foreign-exchange component fell 3.0%
chart.sub: Change in Russian reserves, 31 Aug 2025 to 30 Jun 2026, %.
chart.source: Bank of Russia, International Reserves of the Russian Federation, monthly series.

sections.means: Gold now sits at 41.5% of Russian reserves, up from 37.0% in August 2025.
sections.todo: Publish quarterly rupee balances held in Special Rupee Vostro Accounts, so any build-up is an official figure.

sections.h2: The UAE trades with India at near parity with China; other partners do not

chart.title: Only the UAE trades with China and India on near-equal terms
chart.sub: Trade with China divided by trade with India; India FY2025-26, China calendar 2025.
chart.source: Ministry of Commerce TradeStat; China General Administration of Customs; author's calculations.

sections.means: The UAE is the only one of these four partners that has signed a local-currency settlement arrangement with India, in July 2023.
sections.todo: Scale rupee settlement with the UAE by Indian exports to it, not by diplomacy alone.

sections.h2: China, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Indonesia would earn a pickup on Indian bonds

chart.title: Pickup over India's 10-year yield: +513 bp for China, negative for Russia
chart.sub: 10-year yield pickup from holding Indian government debt, basis points.
chart.source: Policy rates from central banks; market yield indications, late July 2026; author's calculations.

sections.means: A Chinese holder of a ten-year Indian bond earns 513 basis points more than a Chinese government bond pays, a pickup that is compensation for expected depreciation.
sections.todo: India should say plainly that the carry is a real price for deficit financing, not free money.
